1.5.0: Redesigned Theme Selection with live renderer previews and fixed mock telemetry data.
Added looping theme navigation, compact applied/preview indicators, and persistent Apply or non-destructive Cancel actions.
Added a full-screen theme preview with a clear tap-to-return control.
Centralized the theme catalog and decoupled Classic and GT3 renderers from live telemetry for easier future theme expansion.
Kept heartbeat, UDP telemetry, discovery, Wi-Fi and sleep handling independent from theme preview rendering.
1.4.2: Improved Radar theme readability with larger lap, position, fuel, remaining-lap and delta values.
Refined Radar lap formatting with compact spacing around the separator.
Improved Retro theme readability with larger current time, fuel, remaining-lap, lap and position values.
Adjusted Retro current-time and delta placement to prevent overlap.
1.4.1: Fixed touch wake-up when the display sleeps while Settings is open.
Bundled the customized GT7 UDP parser directly with the project for reliable clean builds.
Reduced telemetry heap fragmentation by replacing per-packet dynamic buffers and removing packet dump logging.
1.4.0: Added the Radar dashboard theme with a circular telemetry-driven shift-light display.
Expanded Theme Selection to a four-theme 2 x 2 layout while preserving saved enum values.
Refined Radar timing, pedal, tyre-temperature, ABS/TCS, RPM, speed and gear presentation for the 320 x 240 display.
Separated high-frequency redraw regions to prevent flicker and RPM arc overlap.
1.3.0: Added switchable GT3, Classic, and Retro dashboard themes with persistent on-device selection; GT3 remains the default.
Added the touch Settings menu: tap an active display to open Settings, or tap a sleeping display to wake it.
Added Device Settings with persistent 20–100% brightness control and protected Wi-Fi reset access.
Refined the Classic min-alert RPM marker and increased Retro gear readability.
1.2.7: Added telemetry-driven RPM colours and progressive GT7 shift-warning pulse.
1.2.6: Introduced the refined low-RAM GT3 dashboard UI.
